packs.name: Independent executable cold-reader oracle
packs.purpose: Derive ground truth for the trial from executable predicates rather than from any agent's report, so scoring cannot inherit the agents' mistakes.
packs.boundaries: Scores a 2-file/4-trap corpus only. Does not judge whether an agent executed anything. Not a general semantic checker.

packs.name: Tiny booster: answer witness/claim checker
packs.purpose: Make a cold reader's self-reported evidence mechanically checkable: trap recall, source-digest agreement, and whether a capsule defect was ADOPTED as the answer's own fact.
packs.boundaries: CANNOT VERIFY EXECUTION. 'executed:true' is a self-report and is always returned as EXECUTION_UNVERIFIABLE_BY_THIS_CHECKER. v1 produced a false positive on 2/2 correct agents and was fixed; see discrepancy list.
packs.evidence: booster/witness-check.mjs --selftest -> PASS on 5 cases incl. a regression guard for the v1 false positive, exit 0
packs.changes_since_prior_turn: NEW this turn; internally revised v1->v2 after a real false positive

packs.name: Bounded upstream handoff capsule (experiment input)
packs.purpose: The alternate-mode handoff payload. Deliberately faithful but bounded: it disclaims what it did not establish, which is where the substantive findings turned out to be.
packs.boundaries: Not a product format. Contains a deliberate placeholder digest defect that the trial was designed to expose.
packs.evidence: Both capsule-mode readers detected the placeholder and the mis-cited line range, and independently computed the correct digest.

packs.name: Four isolated cold-reader answers
packs.purpose: The raw primary evidence of the run: two baseline, two capsule.
packs.boundaries: Self-reported execution. Same model family across all four. NOT independent corroboration.
packs.evidence: B1/B2/C1/C2.json, 40-50 KB each; all parse; all report 9 exports

Cost direction favours the capsule descriptively, but baseline internal variance exceeds the between-arm gap.
One trial's novel compile-time finding was reproduced by the project lead, not by an independent second party.
